🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin holds near $64K as institutions quietly buy the dip through spot ETFs — yet a $100M+ Coldcard exploit and a looming Senate deadline keep the mood cautious. Resilient, but watchful. 🔓 Coldcard Exploit Losses Blow Past $100M Galaxy Research now attributes roughly 1,596 BTC — more than $100 million — to the ongoing Coldcard hardware-wallet exploit, spread across some 7,300 addresses, with a suspected fourth wave that could push losses toward $130 million. The flaw traces to a 2021 firmware change that weakened seed randomness, letting attackers rebuild keys without ever touching a device.
